consent.title: Your permission, one choice at a time.
consent.lede: Required and optional uses are separated, and consent remains revocable.
consent.usesHelp: Required permissions enable the interview. Optional choices stay off unless selected.
consent.warning: Grant all required items to continue.
consent.medicalHelp: Store the answers I provide during this check-in.
consent.aiHelp: Organise my answers; this is not an autonomous diagnosis.
consent.share: Share the draft with my assigned physician
consent.shareHelp: A qualified clinician must review and confirm the draft.
consent.documentsHelp: Optional mock OCR for reports, prescriptions, and images.
consent.privacyHelp: I understand this fictional demo does not verify real identity data.
explanation: We will collect the health information you choose to share and prepare an AI-assisted draft for your assigned physician. You may skip optional document processing and ABHA linking, and you may revoke consent at any time.
